lines.2: 「Inori overslept and will be late. I flew on ahead by myself.」
lines.5: 「Now, now, calm yourself, fledgling. Only an ordinary chick cheeps at every little thing. A trained chick sharpens its talons in silence.」
lines.6: I had no idea what he was talking about.
lines.7: 「Let me tell you an edifying story. You see, when we all crowded into the home of someone who owned a television to watch professional wrestling...」
lines.8: Just what era was that bird from...?
